trace.notes: Resolved zbMATH record 66151 to the Springer chapter 'Some Ring Theoretic Techniques and Open Problems in Enveloping Algebras' (DOI 10.1007/978-1-4613-9736-6_2). OpenAlex reports the work as closed access, and the only readable exact-work artifact recovered was the Springer preview PDF.

Mapped the recovered preview PDF. It contains only pages 27-28, showing §1 Introduction and the beginning of §2 Local finiteness. The introduction promises later open problems, but no explicit problem statement is visible in the readable pages.
Moved to needs_review because the exact source resolved only to a two-page preview, so the technical problem statements themselves were not visible and could not be extracted with adequate evidence.
